text: {"rules":[{"id":"OBESITY-BEHAV-INTERV-ADULT","version":"September 2018","title":"Offer or refer adults with BMI 30 or higher to intensive, multicomponent behavioral interventions","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends that clinicians offer or refer adults with a body mass index (BMI) of 30 or higher (calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared) to intensive, multicomponent behavioral interventions.","grade":"B","effective_date":"September 2018","action":"Offer or refer to intensive, multicomponent behavioral weight-loss intervention","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"age\": {\"min\": 18, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"adults\", \"derived\": {\"min\": \"'adults' is not given an age in the text; interpreted as age 18 or older\"}}, {\"observation\": {\"concept\": \"bmi\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"], \"pick\": \"latest\", \"value\": {\"op\": \">=\", \"threshold\": 30, \"unit\": \"kg/m2\"}}, \"quote\": \"body mass index (BMI) of 30 or higher\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"text gives no lookback period; latest BMI in the measurement year assumed\"}}]}","numerator":"{\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"documentation that the clinician offered or referred the patient to an intensive, multicomponent behavioral intervention (offers are not reliably captured in structured EHR data)\"}, \"quote\": \"offer or refer adults\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["Numerator encoded as uncomputable: 'offer or refer' to intensive, multicomponent behavioral interventions has no concept in the vocabulary, and offers are not reliably recorded in structured data. If the clinic can capture referrals, a new concept (e.g. weight_loss_behavioral_intervention_referral) could replace it, but only for referrals, not offers.","Adult age floor (18) is derived; the text only says 'adults'. Requires human review.","BMI lookback window (latest BMI in the measurement year) is derived; the text specifies no timing. Requires human review.","Used observation concept 'bmi' with threshold 30 kg/m2 instead of the 'obesity' condition concept, because 'obesity' in the vocabulary also covers overweight and would over-include patients.","The intervention's intensity, number of sessions, duration and components are not specified in the section and are not represented.","The DATE field carries an asterisk ('September 2018 *') whose footnote is not included in the section; its meaning is not represented.","No exclusions (e.g. pregnancy) are stated in the text, so none were added."]}
